mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_ticket (id, session_id, user_id, title, category, priority, status, assignee, handoff_reason, resolve_note, reopen_count, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms, handoff_at_ms, claimed_at_ms, resolved_at_ms, closed_at_ms, last_user_active_at_ms) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assignee}, #{handoffReason}, #{resolveNote}, #{reopenCount}, #{createdAtMs}, #{updatedAtMs}, #{handoffAtMs}, #{claimedAtMs}, #{resolvedAtMs}, #{closedAtMs}, #{lastUserActiveAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), category = VALUES(category), priority = VALUES(priority), status = VALUES(status), assignee = VALUES(assignee), handoff_reason = VALUES(handoff_reason), resolve_note = VALUES(resolve_note), reopen_count = VALUES(reopen_count), updated_at_ms = VALUES(updated_at_ms), handoff_at_ms = VALUES(handoff_at_ms), claimed_at_ms = VALUES(claimed_at_ms), resolved_at_ms = VALUES(resolved_at_ms), closed_at_ms = VALUES(closed_at_ms), last_user_active_at_ms = VALUES(last_user_active_at_ms)
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, title, category, priority, status, assignee, handoff_reason, resolve_note, reopen_count, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms, handoff_at_ms, claimed_at_ms, resolved_at_ms, closed_at_ms, last_user_active_at_ms FROM cw_ticket WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'RESOLVED') ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, session_id, user_id, title, category, priority, status, assignee, handoff_reason, resolve_note, reopen_count, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms, handoff_at_ms, claimed_at_ms, resolved_at_ms, closed_at_ms, last_user_active_at_ms FROM cw_ticket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'RESOLVED') ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cw_ticket SET status = 'PROCESSING', assignee = #{agentId}, claimed_at_ms = #{nowMs}, updated_at_ms = #{nowMs} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING_AGENT'
